evaluation.scope: 28 frozen synthetic questions; identical corpus, scorer and model configuration
evaluation.note: Both versions fail. The same two correct answers and citations remain; returning fewer citations (10 to 5) raises precision from 20% to 40%. Correct abstention rises from 3/10 to 5/10. Accuracy and citation recall do not improve. This is one internally reviewed synthetic development comparison, not production qualification. Earlier negative experiments remain in the repository.
